acceptanceCriteria: The root cause is identified with file:line and fixed, for example with cmd.WaitDelay or a process group, so a lingering grandchild cannot block the test.
tools/gate-ledger passes -count=20 under parallel load without a hang.
body: Seen 2026-09-25 on the #241 tree: tools/gate-ledger tests hung to the package timeout (1800 s and 600 s runs); a -v rerun passed in 110 s. The goroutine dump shows os/exec's writerDescriptor io.Copy blocked, so a grandchild process (a subprocess go test or git) probably still holds the stdout pipe open after its parent exits. make gate runs this package, so the hang can fail a release gate run.

completion.reason: Fixed in 26612df8 (gate-ledger disables fsmonitor on every git call). Contained in the 1.0.0-rc.1 candidate 94ca556f52c0349c0a48e0c3a3274f8a0b5e6db3 on origin/main. Owner-approved closure 2026-09-27.

title: tools/gate-ledger tests intermittently hang until the package timeout
